analogy.rationale: Bone resorption inhibitors act mainly on osteoclasts, a cell type absent from these nine cancer/epithelial lines, so transcriptional response should be weak; the closest reference classes are those acting on bone/calcium-related nuclear receptors or immune-signaling pathways that overlap minimally with osteoclast biology.
